summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing UK-style PDMR transaction notifications, the US equivalent of Section 16 insider ownership reports. Four executives—Lynn Baxter (President, Europe), CFO Julie Brown, General Counsel James Ford and David Redfern (President, Corporate Development), plus Regis Simard—each acquired 14 ordinary shares at 18.0296 pence on 2026-09-09 through the company's Share Reward Plan, split evenly between 7 partnership and 7 matching shares. The microscopic purchases, roughly £2.5 apiece, are routine compensation-plan disclosures carrying no special-situation content, no board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics; arbitrageurs should ignore.
